fusions.name: Gnaw Line
fusions.desc: Holds 4 charges, one spent on each throw and one returned by each kill. Throws gnawing thread that deals 8 damage, up to 1.4 times that at maximum range. Each hit has a 35% chance to leave the target [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Swarm Spill
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of vermin that deals 12 damage to everything caught in it. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Below Decks
fusions.desc: You take 20% less damage for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Stowaway Brood
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded familiar that fights beside you, striking for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds within 4.5 tiles.
